reason: This is the only offered combination and should show the intake gap to Moth.

effect: Moth recognized that missing records were not missing work and marked the directory unsuitable for estimating local demand. Both chapter goals are complete.
reaction: Moth acknowledging the mistake was a satisfying conclusion to the comparison.

mostWorthwhile.text: Comparing the clinic and depot records was most worthwhile: the intake filter made the difference between an empty count and unmet need concrete.

leastWorthwhile.text: Replacing the board display felt fairly routine, especially as it was the only offered combination.

surprise.text: Moth had recommended keeping vans away based on the incomplete directory, then recognized why that inference was wrong.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary, though several later actions were the only offered combinations rather than meaningful choices.

continue.text: I would continue: the repair work connects to a consequential infrastructure problem, and I am curious how the neighbors will challenge the directory.
